svg.title: PawLocal end-to-end application architecture
svg.desc: Separate development and production AWS environments each contain CloudFront, S3, Cognito, a Lightsail FastAPI service and Aurora DSQL. Browser sessions call the matching HTTPS services. Browser Faro and API OTLP send telemetry directly to external Grafana Cloud. Local Compose uses PostgreSQL and a separate local observability stack. Environment boundaries are logical, not VPC or account claims.
svg.text: Discover a place → inspect details → save, contribute and report
Per environment: scoped runtime IAM role + Parameter Store
Short-lived DSQL credentials · server-only OTLP token · config injected at deploy
Separate reproducible stack · no cloud provisioning
Local Grafana dashboards · local metrics, logs and traces
Service boundaries show logical ownership; no VPC, subnet, account isolation or HA topology is implied.
